create_config_my_new_model: create a MyNewModelConfig instance with default hyperparameters and custom new_param
configure_mlp_bias: configure MLP bias layers in MyNewModelConfig by setting mlp_bias to True
set_new_param: set the custom new_param integer field on MyNewModelConfig instance
configure_rope_scaling: configure RoPE embedding scaling parameters for extended sequence length support
setup_gqa_attention: setup grouped query attention by configuring num_key_value_heads on MyNewModelConfig
